payload.description:
# CLI compare emits guidelineAlignment when OpenAI is configured

## Intent

As a copy-editing agent, I want `limatus compare` to emit `guidelineAlignment` when `OPENAI_API_KEY` is set, so publication `editorialAim` can pick a winner without injecting a Python resolver.

## Done when

- Rank and regression `limatus compare` pass `openai_guideline_alignment` (or equivalent) when `OPENAI_API_KEY` is set.
- With the key unset, `guidelineAlignment` is omitted (Behave already pops the key).
- Offline tests inject/mock the API; no live network in unit tests.
- SDK `compare()` accepts optional `alignment_resolver` and uses the same default-when-key-set behavior as the CLI.

## Out of scope

Auto-applying the alignment winner. Hidden weights.

```gherkin
Feature: CLI compare guideline alignment
  Scenario: Key unset omits guidelineAlignment
    Given OPENAI_API_KEY is unset
    When I run limatus compare with two candidates
    Then the report has no guidelineAlignment key

  Scenario: Injected resolver on CLI path
    When compare runs with a test alignment resolver
    Then guidelineAlignment has question, winnerId, and rationale
```
payload.title: CLI compare emits guidelineAlignment when OPENAI_API_KEY is set
